name: 19140 · Philadelphia, PA
findings: ZIP 19140 (Philadelphia) has 200 nonprofit organizations. 84 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 70 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19140 (Philadelphia) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
